fields.statement: QA round 2 at db1b1c925, scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $SCRATCH/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza): rhiza-x guide plan-reviser prints the rulings section saying to link decided-by in the change set holding the question and its Decision, --record only for a landed record. Re-ran round 1's scenario in a hermetic scratch repo: landed record keep-flat, open change set with Decision settle-x; rhiza-x apply link keep-flat decided-by settle-x --record exits 4 (no node settle-x), the same link with the open change set exits 0 and rhiza-x why keep-flat lists settle-x as decided by; rhiza-x show settle-x names its change set (Created/View what-if). go test ./internal/guide -run TestPlanReviserText ok.

QA round 2 at db1b1c925, scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $SCRATCH/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza): go test ./internal/api -run 'TestRunReviewCheckRulings|TestReviewCheck' ok; TestScripts/describe-golden ok; TestScripts/plan-workflow-autonomous-left (rulings applied, run accepts) and -unapplied (rulings check fails twice, run fails before the gate naming the Decisions) ok.

QA round 2 at db1b1c925, scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $SCRATCH/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza): go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(plan-workflow-autonomous-left|plan-workflow-autonomous-unapplied|plan-workflow-autonomous) ok: rulings step and apply-rulings visit before the gate; with no applied ruling the run fails, no gate, change set stays draft.

QA round 2 at db1b1c925, scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $SCRATCH/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza): the plan-workflow-autonomous-left/-unapplied scripts pass, and by hand a Decision in the open change set links from a landed node in that same change set (apply exit 0).

QA round 2 at db1b1c925, scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $SCRATCH/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza): TestScripts/plan-workflow-autonomous-unapplied passes: run status names each unapplied ruling 'arbiter ruling(s) not applied' with the Decision and finding's node.
